create_index_faiss_flatl2: create a FAISS FlatL2 index from torch tensor embeddings and save to disk
load_text_simple: load a text file into a python list of stripped sentences
compress_text_offsets: generate a binary reference file with byte offsets for each sentence in a text corpus
search_knn_faiss: search a FAISS index for k nearest neighbors and return deduplicated text lines with distances
load_faiss_index: load a FAISS index from disk with optional GPU transfer and nprobe parameter
